question: A component has many handlers updating one state in complex ways, and bugs keep appearing. Which Hook?
say: A component has many handlers that update one state in complex ways, and bugs keep appearing. Which Hook fits?
explanation: The docs recommend a reducer when incorrect state updates cause bugs and you want more structure. It centralizes and logs every update.
explainSay: Use reducer. It brings structure to complex updates and makes each one easy to trace.
